title: Over-air self-sender frames bypass LinkLayer replay protection
description: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py treats frames signed by the local key as trusted loopback and skips replay protection, but an RF attacker can retransmit a recorded self-signed frame. Distinguish internal loopback injection from radio RX and replay-check all over-air self-sender frames; repeated signed wire frame must return REPLAY.
